name: Freight, fleet and warehouse operations software
statusNote: The broader logistics pack, kept separate from logistics-lastmile-tms because the buyers and the disqualifier lists genuinely differ. No Ionic operating company is wired to this pack today. It ships as a working starting point, not as a validated channel set. Enable it only when an opco claims it.

directSites.note: Port and transit authority procurement pages. Most run their own portal rather than posting to a provincial or state one.

must: the solicitation buys software or a software-led service
scope is freight, fleet or warehouse operations rather than last-mile courier

thresholds.note: Same trade-agreement floors as the other Canadian packs. US floors move and are not recorded here.

values.appliesTo: BC, AB, SK, MB goods and services

scoring.weightsNote: dealSize is weighted higher. Public fleet and warehouse systems are larger and slower than last-mile, so a small one is rarely worth the capture cost.

openQuestions: Does any Ionic operating company sell into freight, fleet or warehouse operations? If not, this pack should stay disabled rather than be swept on speculation.

The overlap with logistics-lastmile-tms on the phrase 'transportation management system' is deliberate. Each pack disqualifies the other's core scope, so a hit landing in both means one of the two disqualifier lists needs tightening. Watch for that during calibration.
